title: Group Fitness Class Passes: when a refund of unused credits may be recorded
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for when a refund of a pack's unused credits may be recorded, across every tier of the product. It does not state how the refund amount itself is calculated.

## Eligibility basis still in force
A refund may be entered against a pack only at a moment when that pack's own status, on the system record for that specific pack, is active; a refund is not entered against a pack that fails this status basis and also fails every other route this eligibility basis recognizes to a closed status. Separately, a refund may be recorded only if the customer requests it before the tier's refund window has elapsed since the pack's purchase date, counted as whole calendar days from the purchase date with no rounding down of a partial day; the current moment must not be later than the purchase date plus the tier's refund window for the refund to be recorded.

## Basis no longer in force
The original clause stating that the refund amount is simply the tier's refund percentage of the unused-credit value, prorated on the tier's proration basis, is no longer in force as the complete handling basis for how the refund amount is valued; a fuller reconciliation, deduction and loyalty-bonus basis now governs that valuation.

Separately, the original clause naming the pack's cancellation to closed status being confirmed in that same moment as the route to satisfy this eligibility basis from a non-active status is no longer in force as the complete statement of that route; a broader basis, stated for the specific policy that computes the refund, now governs which routes to a closed status satisfy this same eligibility basis.

## Boundary case for the refund window
Take a pack purchased on a given date whose tier sets a refund window of some whole number of days. On the calendar day that is exactly that many days after the purchase date, a refund request still qualifies (the boundary is inclusive). On the calendar day immediately after that day, a refund request no longer qualifies, because the current moment is then later than the purchase date plus the refund window.

## Points of judgement
- The status basis and the time basis are both independently required: a refund request made in time against a pack that fails the status basis does not qualify, and a status-qualifying request made after the refund window has elapsed does not qualify either.

superseded_clauses: The refund amount is refund_pct of the unused-credit value, prorated on cancellation_refund_basis.
